name: Wisconsin

period.description: Your deductible covers six months in a row; it can start up to three months before the month you apply.

submission.description: Give proof of your medical bills to your income maintenance agency. You (or anyone) can also prepay the deductible, all at once or in parts; if fully paid, coverage starts on the first day of the period.

notes: Unpaid bills and recently paid bills both count. Health insurance premiums count too.
Once you meet the deductible, Medicaid pays covered care until the six months end.
Bills written off in bankruptcy, or paid by insurance, do not count.
If you prepay and your check bounces, you lose eligibility.
